name: MiroMiro Design Extraction API
description:
Turn any live website URL into design data: production-ready section code, brand identity, the full design-token system, and every asset (images, SVGs, fonts, videos, audio, Lottie). Built for developers and AI agents — also available as an MCP server at https://miromiro.app/mcp.

Auth: Bearer key (`mm_live_…`). Get one free at https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding — 300 credits/month, no card. Docs: https://miromiro.app/api/docs (append .md to any docs URL for raw Markdown).
